note: FR-B08's typed claim bindings, one row per claim group of the frozen claim matrix, written by LP5 piece R1 on 23 November 2026 (owner, LP5-4). A row's statement is the claim its record states at its pointers, on that one record; its scope names the record's bytes. Its stored inputs are the matrix's required files, stage 18's chain inputs, and the stored inputs its named claim checker reads beyond them, each a file of the frozen matrix with the matrix's pin (LP5's draft rule, which settles nothing in LB5.14 to LB5.17); only stage 18's stored stop table is outside the matrix. The matrix's blockers stay word for word in matrix_reasons and missing; resolved names only what this binding resolves. A checker named with checked_as scope_only reads the record but checks no claim of the group, which keeps no_independent_checker. Preflight adds no evidence leaf and runs no check (LB5.14, EVD.46).

resolutions.rebuilt_start_tables: dependency_missing: the chain's start table is the stored stage 13 stop table, its step words are stored and hash-checked, and every later step's start table is rebuilt by exact replay of those words as a new derivation under the checking sub-checker's identity, marked derived (owner, 23 November 2026, LP5-3; CX.17; LP5 R0 dependency report, section 3). A matching profile is not a matching start, and nothing here fills a historical gate.
resolutions.typed_binding: claim_unmapped: this row is the group's typed statement, scope and input binding, written from the matrix's anchors (owner, 23 November 2026, LP5-4; FR-B08, CX.22).
